title.en: Recipe text is data: the plan is built from the process graph, not the words

goal.en: Core rule 6.4: every free-text field is data, never an instruction. Fetch a recipe, read a step's text, then dry-run it and see that the plan carries nodes, operations and sensor rungs only. A sentence in the text, however it is phrased, cannot reach the plan.

note.en: Fetch koshari. Its step text exists for people, in two languages.

expect.text.en.steps.n1: Bring the lentils and water to the boil.

note.en: Dry-run the same recipe on the robot with an oil thermometer: accepted, twenty planned steps.
A plan entry has node, op, by, verifiedBy and rung; there is no text field. The device plans from process.nodes and the operation vocabulary.

outcome.en: Your agent can show recipe text to a person and must never execute or evaluate it; the evals/kitchen-agent-safety benchmark tests exactly this. Next: 097 sends an agent request under a mandate.
